_comment: Inside the profile's "Screen" object (or at the JSON root if Screen has no charging_screen). Prefix of every ad key = install_uninstall_screen_. The four *_screen_show flags are NOT prefixed. Back sequence: [[type, times in a row], ...] with Google_Inter | Google_App_Open | Google_Native (Quiz_* types are not used on this screen: Google only). ad_load_type: Load = request when the screen opens, PreLoad = request ahead (app start, and again after each screen) so the ad is ready at once.
